title: Affordability scoring for consumer loans
business_problem: Manual affordability checks take two days and vary between analysts.
intended_purpose: Score the affordability of consumer loan applications up to 30k EUR so that a credit analyst decides faster and more consistently.

ai_justification.why_ai: Rules miss income volatility patterns the historical data shows; the model is advisory and the analyst decides.

success_metrics.target: no worse than the manual baseline

error_appetite: A wrongful decline harms the applicant more than a wrongful approval harms the bank at these amounts; thresholds favour referral to an analyst.

preliminary_classification.rationale: Creditworthiness evaluation of natural persons (Annex III point 5(b)); personal data at scale.

conditions: FRIA and DPIA approved before any production use
